sources: Esri World_Imagery with the per-site points

values.note: The FS page says 80 sites 'with parking areas up to 30 feet long'; recreation.gov warns that RVs or trailers over 36 ft 'will have a very tough time making it through the campground because of tight corners and trees'. The catalog's lengths (41 sites at 30 ft, 19 at 40, a few 45-80, one 100) run longer than either. Rigs must fit the spur; no overflow parking.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/colorado-campground ('This family-oriented campground has 80 campsites with parking areas up to 30 feet long.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232340 (notice 'RV or trailers over 36 feet will have a very tough time ...'; 'There is NO overflow parking in this campground.') + per-site catalog (79 sites besides two host sites), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Two electric sites, 56 (reservable pull-through) and 58 (first-come); amperage not published. All other sites are non-electric.

hookups.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 232340 (every site 'Water Hookup: No', 'Sewer Hookup: No'; sites 056 and 058 type STANDARD ELECTRIC, no amperage attribute) + /rates ('STANDARD ELECTRIC - SITES 56 & 58'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Hydrants may not be used to fill RV tanks (state rule). Amphitheater with weekend campfire programs.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/colorado-campground (Restrooms 'Restroom, Vault toilets'; 'Potable water is available at this site.') + recreation.gov notice ('Colorado State regulations prohibit attaching hoses to hydrants to fill RV's'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend, weather permitting (the FS page's 'Seasons of Use' dates, May 26 - September 4, are a past year's).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/colorado-campground (Current Conditions 'The campground is open from Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend, depending on weather.'; Seasons of Use 'May 26 - September 4'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 49 of the 79 sites are reservable, up to four days before arrival; the rest are first-come and must be occupied the same night. Up to 14 days in a 30-day period. Concessionaire-run; check in with the host.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/colorado-campground ('Limited campsites reservation can be made four days prior to arrival'; 'First-come, first-served sites must be occupied the same night.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232340 (rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 4; notice 'Maximum 14-day stay limit within 30-day period'; rates Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-06) + catalog (49 reservable, 30 not), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $28 a site (two vehicles or one RV included); electric sites 56 and 58 $38; third vehicle $11. Same for 2027.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/colorado-campground ('$28.00 fee per site for overnight camping. Two vehicles or one RV per site is included in the camping fee. $11.00 for a third vehicle.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232340/rates (2026 and 2027 STANDARD NONELECTRIC 28, 'STANDARD ELECTRIC - SITES 56 & 58' 38), read 2026-10-28

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/colorado-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Pikes Peak RD (Pike-San Isabel NF), concessionaire-run, in ponderosa pine at ~7,800 ft on CO-67 about 7 miles north of Woodland Park; a short trail and the paved Centennial Trail lead to Manitou Lake. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed 79 sites (FS says 80), $28 (2026/2027), vault toilets and water, no water/sewer hookups. Replaced the 100-ft placeholder with the FS page's 30 ft; added the two electric sites (56 reservable, 58 first-come; $38, amperage unpublished), season Memorial Day - Labor Day, booking rules (4-day cutoff, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimum, 14 in 30 days, reservation season May 22 - Sept 6), electric surcharge, senior/access discount. Pin 222 m from the site centroid, at site 61's corner of the loop; OK. Not waterfront confirmed: Manitou Lake is ~400 m NW across CO-67. Note corrected (wrong district) and trimmed.
flags: Length sources differ: FS page 'parking areas up to 30 feet long' (recorded), recreation.gov 'RV or trailers over 36 feet will have a very tough time making it through the campground because of tight corners and trees', catalog 30-80 ft (and a 100-ft placeholder at site 19). EKKO fits under all of them.

Electric: sites 56 and 58 are STANDARD ELECTRIC at $38 (56 reservable, 58 first-come; neither is a host site - the host sites are 1 and 60), but no source gives the amperage, so hookups.electric stays unset.

Wrong district in the old note: the FS page puts it in the Pikes Peak Ranger District, not 'Eleven Mile/Lake George (South Platte RD)'. Missing phone: Pikes Peak Ranger District, 719-636-1602 (FS page; recreation.gov gives the same as 'INFORMATION ONLY').
Website: stored link is the recreation.gov booking page; the FS page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/colorado-campground.
